name: X402 Merchant
description: Builds a paid content store on Cloudflare Workers, keeping files in a private R2 catalogue behind a one-cent USDC paywall on Base, with settlement handled via Coinbase CDP. Presumes you are comfortable with crypto payments and Cloudflare infrastructure rather than a conventional card checkout.
